verdict: Quiet day: one genuine pipeline-relevant renderer update and one VFX breakdown with no technical substance given; little that demands action this week.

stories.headline: Redshift 2027.0 adds fur procedural, ACES 2 support, Redshift Live updates
stories.body: Maxon has released Redshift 2027.0, adding a new fur procedural, ACES 2 colour management support, and updates to the real-time Redshift Live render engine. This is a point release to an existing commercial GPU renderer used across Houdini, Maya, Cinema 4D and other DCCs. ACES 2 support is the detail worth checking against current studio colour pipelines; the fur procedural may affect grooming workflows.
stories.why: ACES 2 support changes colour-management decisions for studios already on Redshift.
